# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| >= 1.0  | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, please report them to the project maintainers privately. You can do this by sending a direct message to the maintainers on Discord. We take security seriously and will try to address the issue as quickly as possible.
